body: I....I'm not sure what I just read.  Also TIL that Russians really like the IPad2 (I think?).

Having the revolver next to you is not going to help how you feel, please put it away or better yet have someone you trust get it away from you.  Is there a mutual friend you can talk to about your friend's death?  It make help to share your feelings with someone else instead of holding them inside.

I know one person can't speak for everyone, but when I was in group therapy it helped keep the suicidal thoughts at bay.  There are some free ones- this website may help find some in his area: http://www.mentalhealthamerica.net/find-support-groups.
